description: When a task is checked off in the spec's task list, run the test suite for the affected module and report the result next to the task.
name: test-on-task-complete

then.prompt: A task in .kiro/specs/skeleton-core/tasks.md was just checked off. Identify the module it belongs to, run that module's tests (npm test from the repo root runs everything), and report pass/fail counts. If anything fails, do not move on to the next task — report the failure first.
